description: This Java class defines a RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying account items in an Android application, specifically for a Nextcloud Notes client. It binds account data to UI elements and handles click events.

classes.name: AccountSwitcherViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder that binds account data to UI components for display in a list.

methods.name: AccountSwitcherViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with the provided item view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an Account object to the UI elements and sets up click handling.
